acceptance_contract.bridge_success_branch: AUGMENTED_1_2_EXCHANGE_GRAPH_CONNECTED_ALL_SEEDS_BY_CERTIFIED_SUBGRAPH only when deterministic bridge selection reduces every authenticated V4.0 seed component inventory to one component
acceptance_contract.inconclusive_branch: V41_BRIDGE_CONNECTIVITY_INDETERMINATE when any required audit, replay, identity or component proof is incomplete
acceptance_contract.primary_resource_pass: PASS only when R2 connectivity and all proof gates pass and the maximum selected-model R2 CNOT numerator across all eight frozen seeds is at most 2500000

bridge_protocol.adjacency_extension: In addition to every V4.0 feasible Hamming-distance-two edge, a registered bridge joins two exactly feasible K-subsets whose Hamming distance is four
bridge_protocol.audit_scope: Exhaust all C(10,2)*C(30,2) two-out/two-in candidates incident to every singleton component authenticated by V4.0
bridge_protocol.canonical_candidate_order: For each source: removed indices ascending lexicographic pair, then added indices ascending lexicographic pair
bridge_protocol.component_membership_rule: A feasible target distinct from every V4.0 singleton representative belongs to the only remaining component when the authenticated seed inventory consists of one non-singleton component plus singleton components
bridge_protocol.connectivity_certificate: The authenticated complete V4.0 one-swap component forest plus every deterministically selected exact two-swap bridge is a spanning subgraph. Connectivity of this subgraph proves connectivity of the full one-plus-two-swap supergraph.
bridge_protocol.kruskal_order: Within each seed sort candidate bridges by normalized V4.0 component-representative pair, normalized endpoint-mask pair, removed pair and added pair; accept iff the endpoints currently occupy distinct DSU components
bridge_protocol.selection_stop_rule: Continue deterministic Kruskal selection until the seed is connected or the complete registered candidate list is exhausted
bridge_protocol.selected_subgraph_edge_count: Authenticated V4.0 exact one-swap edge count plus successful registered bridge unions; this is not the full augmented edge count

registered_resource_candidates.move_family: ALL FEASIBLE HAMMING_DISTANCE_TWO SWAPS PLUS SELECTED CERTIFIED HAMMING_DISTANCE_FOUR BRIDGES

exploratory_observation.scope: Unsealed Python engineering audit of all 19575 two-out/two-in candidates incident to each of the three V4.0 isolated portfolios
exploratory_observation.use: Motivated the sealed bridge compiler; no count, target, digest or final decision is an acceptance expectation

protocol_amendments.reason: The first confirmatory attempt failed closed because the independent C++ SHA-256 implementation contained two truncated hexadecimal round constants. Candidate records agreed across implementations, but no evidence or decision was accepted. The constants and engine identity were corrected; all algorithms, branch rules, candidate ordering and resource rules remained unchanged.

Before the first mixer resource ledger, the preregistered measurement-free ripple architecture was completed with the published Cuccaro modulo-adder and comparator primitive counts and an explicit controlled-gate lift. Compression proof development had begun, but no candidate CNOT numerator or budget outcome had been computed. No candidate family, connectivity rule or budget was changed.

compression_protocol.canonical_margin_witness_order: Minimum (distance, portfolio mask, threshold tag LOWER before UPPER, exact sum)
compression_protocol.canonical_error_witness_order: Maximum absolute residual, then minimum portfolio mask, then signed residual
compression_protocol.classification_domain: COMPLETE GROUP-BAND-VALID EXACT-K UNIVERSE, independently for every factor row and seed
compression_protocol.coefficient_rule: b_i is a_i divided by 2^s rounded to nearest integer; exact half ties choose the even integer using Euclidean divmod
compression_protocol.error_bound: Exact maximum over the complete registered domain of abs(sum_i (a_i-2^s*b_i) x_i), reproduced by both MITM partitions
compression_protocol.identity_shift_rule: s=0 is exact by identity even when the minimum threshold distance is zero
compression_protocol.margin_certificate: Exact minimum over the complete registered domain of min(abs(A-L),abs(A-U)), with canonical witnesses and dual-partition equality
compression_protocol.parity_gate: For s>0 require exact_error_bound < exact_minimum_threshold_distance, then independently replay original-versus-compressed classification over the complete MITM domain
compression_protocol.rejection_policy: Any row without complete dual evidence, strict certificate or exact predicate parity forces the candidate resource architecture to fail closed
compression_protocol.shift_search_range: All integers from zero through max_i bit_length(abs(a_i)) plus two, evaluated without early stopping
compression_protocol.shift_selection: Choose the greatest nonnegative s satisfying every registered proof condition; ties are impossible
compression_protocol.threshold_rounding: lower=ceil(L/2^s), upper=floor(U/2^s), both by exact signed integer arithmetic

resource_compiler_contract.bridge_template: Exact two-level rotation on the full data-plus-guarded-slack joint register along the lexicographically earliest differing-bit Gray path, using forward and inverse C^(m-1)X conjugations and one C^(m-1)RY
resource_compiler_contract.cache_preparation: Caller-supplied coherent guarded-slack caches; a separate exact selected-model preparation ledger is mandatory and excluded from the mixer-layer numerator
resource_compiler_contract.cache_semantics: For compressed row sum B, lower l, upper u and G=max_i,j abs(b_i-b_j), store guarded unsigned slack Z=(B-l)+G. Feasible support is G<=Z<=G+(u-l).
resource_compiler_contract.dead_edge_policy: Retain each of 780 lexicographic asset-pair positions as a live pair-action or an exact row-disjointness identity; no sampling-based removal

ripple_macro_counts_for_width_w_at_least.controlled_modular_constant_add_selected: 18*(2*w-3)+6*(5*w-7)+(2*w-6)=68*w-102; obtained by adding one clean predicate control to each 2*w-3 Toffoli, 5*w-7 CNOT and 2*w-6 X primitive of the Cuccaro modulo-2^w adder
ripple_macro_counts_for_width_w_at_least.scratch_contract: One w-bit constant register, one carry, orientation, bound flags, row flags and aggregate are returned clean; constant-register X preparation contributes no CNOT

resource_compiler_contract.no_wrap_proof: On feasible support Z lies in [G,G+u-l]; one swap delta lies in [-G,G], so normalized Z+delta lies in [0,2G+u-l], fully represented by guard_width
resource_compiler_contract.one_swap_template: V3.9 exact cache-normalized pair-action topology replayed in guarded-slack coordinates: compute different-bit guard, normalize, compute exact interval flags, aggregate, Gray-conjugated controlled RY, uncompute flags, denormalize with the new endpoint orientation, clear scratch
resource_compiler_contract.ordered_layer: All 780 canonical one-swap positions in lexicographic i,j order, followed for R2 only by selected bridges in registered Kruskal order
resource_compiler_contract.resource_numerator: One complete ordered mixer layer; no cancellation between macros or positions
resource_compiler_contract.two_level_bridge_cost: For joint register width m and joint endpoint Hamming distance h, 2*h occurrences of C^(m-1)X-equivalent cost, including the two C^(m-1)X gates that synthesize C^(m-1)RY
resource_compiler_contract.zero_span_policy: A row with u=l is represented and checked exactly; register width remains at least one
